g.text: A certified normal form for runtime updates: decide Repair vs. Invalidate vs. other terminals by computing the obstruction.
Declare the boundary of the view/cache (∂Q).
This boundary is fixed before runtime.
Given write event e, delta program ΔQ(e) is computable.
Map defect ω(e) to quotient class Q¹ = C¹/im(d₀).
Exact repair is possible iff [ω(e)] = 0 (i.e., ω = d₀α).
There exists α ∈ C⁰ such that
Only class zero admits exact repair.
RUNNING EXAMPLE – Materialized View: paid_revenue_by_customer(customer_id, paid_revenue = SUM(amount))
Changed: amount. Predicate status='paid': both True
Outcome: Repair applied precisely and safely.
Outcome: Escalate or recompute at higher level.
A system should not guess what a write breaks.
It should compute the obstruction and follow a declared terminal.
Exact Repair ⟺ [ω(e)] = 0 in Q¹ ⟺ ω(e) ∈ im(d₀) ⟺ ∃α ∈ C⁰ : ω(e) = d₀α
